column3: Silberberg Guarantor and Karasick Guarantor are defendants in an alleged breach of contract case filed by a plaintiff in the Southern District of New York. The plaintiff claims that it is entitled under a certain put option agreement, to which neither Silberberg Guarantor nor Karasick Guarantor is a party, to exit the related transaction to recoup its investment. Silberberg Guarantor and Karasick Guarantor have filed a motion to dismiss given that Silberberg Guarantor and Karasick Guarantor are not parties to the put option agreement, and, according to the borrower sponsor, the plaintiff has opposed the motion to dismiss as of July 2025.
